payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: Multi-scale joint attention over patch sizes 2, 4, 7 captures both sub-cellular nuclear morphology and broader tissue architecture in a single forward pass, outperforming single-scale approaches on 28x28 histopathology patches where visual ambiguity between classes (background/debris/mucus, smooth muscle/stroma) requires multi-granularity discrimination. Hidden width 128 with depth 2 provides sufficient capacity for ~90k samples while avoiding overfitting on the 196-token fine-scale branch.
